about: Water names in OR's records that data/receiving-waters-national.json does not hold for OR: DEQ's OERS spill archive (2013 to March 2025, the 2,371 sewage reports; Affected_Waterway, once per report), Portland Environmental Services' advisories (the waters each names) and OHA's bloom advisories (the water's name), read 2026-11-07. One row per name and county, with the towns (most reports first), the source ids and the permits. Reports that say the sewage reached no water, or name none, are left out (by_reason). Names are kept as the source spells them. Written by scripts/or_report_water_names.py.
